# ssp_sensor_registration_token (Resource)

Creates a sensor registration token for onboarding NDR sensors to the SSP platform.

Tokens are valid for **30 minutes** and allow up to `allowed_instance_count` sensor registrations.
The `registration_manifest` attribute contains the value to supply to the sensor installer.

Corresponds to `POST/DELETE /sensors/registration-tokens`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name for the registration token.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) Passphrase to secure the registration token (minimum 15 characters). Write-only.

### Optional

- `allowed_instance_count` (Number) Maximum number of sensors that may register with this token. Defaults to `1`.
- `description` (String) Optional description for the token.

### Read-Only

- `expiration` (Number) Unix epoch timestamp (milliseconds) when the token expires.
- `id` (String) Unique UUID of the token assigned by SSP.
- `number_available` (Number) Number of additional sensors that can still register with this token.
- `registration_manifest` (String, Sensitive) Opaque registration manifest to supply to the sensor installer. Sensitive.
- `status` (String) Token status: `AVAILABLE`, `EXHAUSTED`, or `EXPIRED`.
- `usage_count` (Number) Number of sensors already registered with this token.
